module.title: Medical Education and Continuing Professional Development
module.business_purpose: A learning platform for doctors and staff (the "doctor courses" the clients asked for): structured courses with modules and lessons, instructors, cohorts and enrollments, progress tracking, assessments/quizzes with attempts and grading, completion certificates, and accredited Continuing-Medical-Education (CME) credits tied to a practitioner's specialties and jurisdiction licensing (module 05). Content is governed and versioned; certificates are verifiable. Integrates with scheduling for live sessions and payments for paid courses.
